text.title: Manual Override
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_mood: Dry, defensive, over-analytical, quietly ashamed → warmer, embodied, gently defiant, self-trusting
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive busker groove, Lo-fi hip-hop drums: soft kick, brushed snare, hand taps, Warm upright-style bass, Sparse piano enters after second hook, Subtle room noise and chair creaks for intimacy, Live, imperfect, close mix, Full-stop dropouts before punchlines, Final third adds soft harmonies and warmer bass, staying raw and uncluttered,
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male vocal, Spoken-word rap verses with conversational phrasing, precise pauses, and dry comic timing, Soft indie-folk sung hook with fragile warmth, Starts controlled and self-mocking, becomes more open and grounded, Close-mic verses, slight rasp on punchlines, occasional whispered doubles on repeated phrases, Final section more melodic and less guarded,
section_names: Intro – spoken | dry, close-mic | sparse guitar
Verse 1 – spoken rap | light guitar groove
Verse 2 – spoken rap | drums enter, brushed snare
Verse 3 – warmer spoken rap | piano enters lightly
Outro – spoken, slight smile | instruments fading

transcription.text: Please remain calm, I have reviewed the situation, and after careful consideration, I have decided I am probably the situation, which is inconvenient. I used to think if I could name every wire, I could stop the whole house from catching fire, label the switches, diagram the sparts, but little warning signs over the difficult parts. This one controls the childhood, this one makes jokes when afraid. This one says, I'm fine so convincingly, even I file it away. Someone said, you don't have to explain yourself, which is sweet, also suspicious, because I have met myself and frankly, context helps. There are doors in me that open sideways, there are stairs that forget what height is. There are rooms where the light switch works, but only if no one asks why it's like this. And yes, I know that sounds dramatic, but so is pretending a locked basement is just storage, because the listing said, open plan, maybe I made the map too large, maybe I made too many roads, maybe I turned every store into something, but the code I'm looking for the manual override, something in need, still alive, past the warning lights, past the reasons I provide, I'm more than the fool I find, more than the wires I hide behind. And if you stay beside the noise, you might hear my actual voice. It's under settings, obviously, nested for no reason. I used to rehearse being human, like there'd be a practical exam, smile here, pause there, ask about there weekend, do not mention mortality, before the second drink I learn, I contact like a hostage negotiation, too little, suspicious, too much cult leader, somewhere in the middle, there is apparently friendship, I make plans with the version of me who believes in calendars, then actual me arrives, wearing yesterday's weather and holding one shoot for reasons, still under investigation, and people say, just tell me what you need, as if need is a clean little package with a bow and a tracking number, sometimes need is fog, sometimes need is a chair, sometimes need is leaving the room, before my face starts, making statements, my mouth cannot legally defend, sometimes I don't know, until the damage is sent to receipt, but I am trying, badly with paperwork, I'm looking for the manual, override, something in me, still alive, past the warning lights, cast the reasons I provide, I'm more than the fool I find, more than the wires I hide behind, if you stay beside the noise, you might hear my actual voice, when I get tired of being both the fire and the evacuation plan, of saying sorry for the smoke while still coughing from the room that made it, I know I can be sharp, I have watched my words leave my mouth wearing boots, I have seen kindness come out crooked, because it had to pass through old machinery, but listen, not every alarm is manipulation, not every shutdown is refusal, not every silence is punishment, sometimes the system is not ignoring you, sometimes it is using everything it has, not to disappear, so here is the part where I stop pretending itself, now it is the same thing as self trust, because I know the patterns, I know the loops, I know the exits I choose, then accuse of being proof, but I can't help it, I can't name the weather, that doesn't mean I have to become a fool, a cast forever, maybe the override was never the lever behind glass, maybe it was smaller, a breath before the joke attacks, before the vanishing, a hand on the table, instead of a case for the defense, maybe I say I'm overwhelmed, before I turn into a fainter, maybe you say take your time, but I'm making time sound like alone, as a place between full disclosure and closed doors, between here is every wound, and nothing to see here, I'm trying to stand there, not perfectly, not politely, but present, I'm looking for the manual, override, something in still a life past, the warning lights, past the reasons, I provide, I'm more than, more I find, more than the wires I hide behind, if you stay beside the noise, you might hear my actual voice, I'm looking for the manual override, and not to erase what I survive, just to choose the door of this time, before they hold the lawns, decide, so, I may require patience, I may ride strength, and I may need to restart the sentence several times, but I've not broken the sheet, I am a person, learning which buttons, were never meant to be pressed, and which ones were mine, all the line, back
